title: Chaos Shuffle
description: Every live player passes their entire hand to the player on their left simultaneously.

canonical.sandbox:
def apply(state, ctx):
    live = []
    for pid in state.turn_order:
        if not state.player(pid).eliminated:
            live.append(pid)
    if len(live) < 2:
        state.note('Chaos Shuffle needs at least two live players.')
        return
    actor = ctx.get('actor_id') or state.actor_id
    start = live.index(actor)
    order = live[start:] + live[:start]
    marker_key = 'chaos_shuffle_origin'
    marker_value = ctx.get('card_id') or 'chaos_shuffle'
    state.set_card_attribute('all_in_hand', marker_key, marker_value)
    for index in range(1, len(order)):
        state.move_cards(from_zone='hand', selector='all', count=50, from_player='id:' + order[index], to_zone='hand', to_player='id:' + order[index - 1])
    tagged = 'attr:' + marker_key + '=' + marker_value
    state.move_cards(card_target=tagged, to_zone='hand', to_player='id:' + order[-1])
    state.set_card_attribute(tagged, marker_key, None)

args.note: Recite from memory every card that has been played this game. The table adjusts this award to 1 point per correctly named card (3 is the recorded default).

title: Mystery Box
description: Discard 1 random card from your hand, then draw 2 cards.

title: The Epilogue
description: Keep this card. If you are still holding it when the game ends, you gain a decisive 100-point bonus — enough to steal the win.

args.title: The owner gains 100 points at the end of the game.

canonical.sandbox:
def apply(state, ctx):
    state.register_hook('on_game_end', scope='player', code="def apply(state, ctx):\n    state.add_points('self', 100)\n", title='The owner gains 100 points at the end of the game.', condition_keys=[])
